items.exampleEn: Dissatisfied workers left the company one after another.
items.exampleZh: 不滿的員工一個接一個離開了公司。

items.exampleEn: My grandfather is an eloquent storyteller.
items.exampleZh: 我爺爺說起故事來很有口才。

items.exampleEn: We felt sorry for them in their misfortune.
items.exampleZh: 我們很同情他們的不幸遭遇。

items.exampleEn: Her reverence for nature shows in all her paintings.
items.exampleZh: 她對大自然的崇敬，表現在她的每一幅畫裡。

items.exampleEn: The team's behavior was a disgrace to the school.
items.exampleZh: 那支球隊的行為讓學校蒙羞。

items.exampleEn: We were ecstatic to see our old friend at the airport.
items.exampleZh: 在機場見到老朋友，我們欣喜若狂。

items.exampleEn: Her patience with the children is admirable.
items.exampleZh: 她對孩子們的耐心令人欽佩。

items.exampleEn: He generously paid for everyone's dinner.
items.exampleZh: 他大方地請大家吃晚餐。

items.sentenceEn: It was our misfortune to arrive just as the shop closed.
items.sentenceZh: 我們很倒楣，剛好在店關門時才到。

items.audioEn: In this village, people treat the old bridge with great reverence.
items.audioZh: 在這個村子裡，大家都非常敬重那座老橋。
items.questionZh: 村民怎麼看待那座老橋？
options: They think the bridge is too old
They want to build a new bridge

items.sentenceEn: Visitors walked quietly through the ancient temple, full of reverence.
items.sentenceZh: 遊客懷著崇敬的心，安靜地走過那座古老的寺廟。

items.sentenceEn: The kids were ecstatic when it started to snow.
items.sentenceZh: 開始下雪的時候，孩子們樂翻了。

items.stemEn: ____ with his old haircut, he tried a completely new style.
items.stemZh: 他對舊髮型不滿意，就試了一個全新的造型。

items.stemEn: My neighbor ____ lent us his car for the whole weekend and said we didn't need to pay.
items.stemZh: 鄰居很大方地把車借我們開整個週末，還說不用付錢。

items.passageEn: Last Friday, our school held the final of its English debate contest. Mina, a quiet girl from my class, was surprisingly eloquent, and her arguments were clear and coherent. When the judges named her team the winner, she was ecstatic and hugged everyone. The other team was dissatisfied with the result at first, but their captain generously shook hands with Mina and praised her speech. Everyone agreed that this was admirable. At the end, our principal said that losing is no disgrace if you have done your best.
items.passageZh: 上週五，我們學校舉辦了英語辯論比賽的決賽。我班上安靜的女生 Mina 口才出奇地好，論點清楚又有條理。評審說她的隊伍獲勝時，她欣喜若狂，抱了每一個人。另一隊一開始對結果不滿意，但他們的隊長大方地和 Mina 握手，還稱讚她的發言。大家都認為這很令人欽佩。最後，校長說，只要盡了力，輸了也不丟臉。

questions.questionZh: 另一隊的隊長後來怎麼做？
options: 要求評審重新計算一次分數
大方握手並稱讚她的演講
明年的比賽會增加更多獎金
輸的一隊應該向贏家道歉

items.promptZh: 考試作弊是件丟臉的事。
referenceEn: Cheating on a test is a disgrace.
It is a disgrace to cheat in an exam.
rubricZh: disgrace 的用法，例如 is a disgrace、It is a disgrace to… 等
時態合理（例如 is 等）

items.promptZh: 他總是把自己的不幸怪罪到別人身上。
referenceEn: He always blames other people for his own misfortune.
He always blames others for his misfortune.
rubricZh: misfortune 表示「不幸、厄運」（例如 his own misfortune 等）
「怪罪到別人身上」可寫，例如 blame others for…、blame other people for… 等
always 位置不扣分；時態可用現在式或過去式（例如 blames、blamed 等）
